note: The exact Bytefray Spectator build the Windows installer bundles. Spectator is a separate application with its own version series; this pin records which build this Bytefray release was qualified with. tools/build_win.ps1 -SpectatorExe refuses any executable whose SHA-256 differs, and stages this record beside it as SPECTATOR_BUILD.json.
name: Bytefray Spectator

build.engine: Godot 4.7.2.stable, official Windows x86_64 release export template
build.preset: Windows Desktop (packaging/export_presets.cfg, single executable with embedded .pck)
build.reproducibility: Godot exports are not byte-reproducible: rebuilding the same commit changes generated import IDs and caches inside the embedded .pck. The pinned hash identifies this one build.
